scope: Independent review of the setup continuation only: library 1.0.1 documentation, receipt integrity, metadata-routing evidence and three explicitly invoked Codex CLI synthetic pilots. No review of all upstream repositories or release approval.

findings.effect: Startup warning disclosure is incomplete, although successful skill-resource reads and semantic pilot acceptance are unaffected.
findings.evidence: Each of the three captured native event streams contains one completed item of type error whose message warns that the existing local_thread_store_compression feature is under development. The public summary mentions icon-path and state-db warnings only. All thirteen command items exit 0 and all three streams end in turn.completed.
findings.reproduction: Inspect item.completed records whose item.type is error in each local native pilot event stream; do not publish raw local log paths or alter global configuration.
findings.recommendation: Mention the existing under-development-feature startup warning in the sanitized summary; retain that it is not a failed pilot command.

checks.evidence: All three raw answer SHA-256 values match the public report; parsed public answers exactly equal raw answers after home-path redaction. Every loaded resource path exists and matches observed cat commands. Completed command counts 4/4/5, exit code 0 throughout; three turn.completed events. No network, mutation, target code, script, or other action tool appears in captured agent items.

checks.name: native-semantic-acceptance
checks.evidence: Independently read all three answers. Code: grounded locator and denominator defect, unseen-guard caveat, no formal-spec pass, positive sign domain, test blindspot and no test-execution claim. KPI: 110/150 = 73.3333%, mean 70%, 3.3333 percentage-point gap, stock snapshot aggregation withheld and synthetic policy boundary explicit. Thesis: partial two-of-five-chapter coverage, +20 percentage points distinguished from causality, generalization/data limitations, fake DOI unverified and no rubric score.

checks.name: routing-evidence
checks.evidence: Twelve saved responses match all twelve expected selections and fixture IDs; five supplied name/description metadata entries match current skill frontmatter. Positive, negative and mixed cases included. Evidence is one fresh-context classifier sample covering twelve cases, not independently observed host automatic routing or a broad accuracy estimate.

checks.name: reported-static-verification
checks.evidence: Read current setup-verification.json: all eleven check entries exit 0; unittest totals 28+36+6+7 = 77 canonical and 64 legacy, five official format validations and three UI YAML records. These test runs were performed by builder; this reviewer independently ran hash/inventory/event/answer/metadata/archive checks with existing venv Python -B.

checks.name: public-scope-and-report-consistency
checks.evidence: Reviewed new README, CHANGELOG, QUICKSTART, plan, governance quality, Codex adapter, registry and requested reports. Three core pilot versus six deferred P2/P3 workflows is explicit; no full-adapter, implicit-discovery, real-data, performance-benefit or release claim. Current three core runtime_scope fields specify explicit CLI USER pilot while full lifecycle remains unverified. Sanitized new documents contain no concrete user-home path; packets use synthetic entities/data. No missing local document link except setup-challenger.json, intentionally produced from this review after completion.

limitations: Pilot process exit codes and CLI version are builder-captured metadata; raw event streams substantiate successful turn completion and command exits, but do not independently encode the outer process exit or CLI version.
Initial host metadata presence is agent-reported, not separately instrumented; explicit invocation and resource reads are observed.
Pinned remote tree snapshot supplied by builder was checked locally against Git blob bytes; this reviewer made no external calls and does not independently attest remote service authenticity.
Source receipt equality demonstrates byte preservation, not comprehensive host filesystem/configuration history. No assertion that unrelated global settings were inspected or changed.
Public-output review covered changed evidence/documents and synthetic inputs, not exhaustive DLP or entire upstream source review.
Routing expected-before-answer chronology relies on supplied workflow evidence; saved files prove correspondence, not a tamper-proof timestamp.

One session per core skill and one routing classifier sample do not establish reliability, implicit routing, other-client behavior, update/uninstall lifecycle, production acceptance or measured productivity.
declined_to_judge: Merge, release/deployment approval or rollback execution.
Real banking policy, credit/HR/legal decisions, academic grading or real customer data.
Unchanged upstream source outside the scoped setup continuation; authenticity inferred solely from hash equality.
Global plugin/config enablement or repair; startup warnings did not authorize configuration changes.
